title: New feature: Keep the predicted blood glucose curve onscreen and unchanged once an input has been added
symptom: When you input an insulin dose or carbs, xDrip shows a predicted blood glucose curve that updates with each new data point, making it hard to see where predictive variables (carb ratio, insulin sensitivity, carb absorption rate) are incorrect.
evidence_quote: This initial predictive 'simulation' curve is updated for each data point received from that point onwards. This doesn't give you an easy picture to see where your predictive variables are incorrect.
